name: How to Add a Watermark to a PDF
description: Add custom text watermarks to every PDF page — free, processed locally.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Customize the watermark
step.text: Type your watermark text, choose font size, opacity, color, and angle (diagonal or tiled). Preview updates live.

step.name: Download the watermarked PDF
step.text: Click 'Watermark PDF'. Every page of your document has the watermark baked in permanently.
